rules: Only supplied visible event candidates may be ranked; runtime option text and structured signed consequences remain authoritative.
Protocol-sensitive multi-stage interactions such as Match and Keep and exact card grids remain deterministic.
Disabled, unaffordable and lethal options are removed before model ranking.
Visible option text and structured costs override remembered event outcomes.

COUNCIL_OF_GHOSTS.accept: Lose 50% Max HP and receive 5 Apparition, or 3 at Ascension 15+. Toxic Egg upgrades the received cards and removes their Ethereal drawback.
COUNCIL_OF_GHOSTS.ranking: Compare post-choice current/max HP, Apparition count, deck access and existing block/draw/retain support; do not use a fixed Max-HP threshold.

VAMPIRES.blood_vial: If available, lose Blood Vial, remove all Strikes and receive exactly 5 Bites.
VAMPIRES.accept: Remove all Strikes, receive exactly 5 Bites and lose 30% Max HP.
VAMPIRES.ranking: Compare exact Strike count, deck-size delta, sustain need, healing restrictions and the actual Blood Vial or Max-HP opportunity cost.

WINDING_HALLS.madness: Receive 2 Madness and lose 12.5% Max-HP worth of current HP, increased to 18% at Ascension 15+.
WINDING_HALLS.focus: Receive Writhe and heal 25% Max HP, reduced to 20% at Ascension 15+; Omamori may prevent Writhe.
WINDING_HALLS.ranking: Compare the signed post-choice state; Writhe is an Innate unplayable curse, not a free heal.

MIND_BLOOM.war: Fight a random Act 1 boss and receive its normal combat rewards, a rare relic, and 50 Gold (25 at Ascension 15+).
MIND_BLOOM.awake: Upgrade all upgradable cards and obtain Mark of the Bloom, permanently preventing healing.
MIND_BLOOM.rich: Gain 999 Gold and receive 2 Normality; this third option appears on floors 35 through 40.
MIND_BLOOM.healthy: Heal to full HP and receive Doubt; this replaces Rich on floor 41 and above.
MIND_BLOOM.ranking: Awake is always the second option and is not Healthy. Never hard-reject Awake merely because current HP is below maximum; price all upgrades against permanent healing loss and remaining Act 3/Act 4 risk.
